question: Why do the wise know this center as svādhiṣṭhāna in relation to the supreme liṅga?
premises: The supreme liṅga is associated with the sound sva.
This association gives rise to the name svādhiṣṭhāna.
inference: Because of the sound sva associated with the supreme liṅga, the wise know it as svādhiṣṭhāna.
plain_english: Because of the sound sva, the wise know the supreme liṅga as svādhiṣṭhāna.
